## Description

When all of the session slots for an org are filled a queue builds up while it waits for sessions to be closed.  a queued session already has a session id, a claimed host. it’s a real live session, just without activity yet. I don’t like this. it should be a queued ticket that’s waiting for an available host, not an already created session that’s only waiting for permission to start.

And if Auto is turned off items can remove themselves from the queue without messing with already created sessions.
